schema.title: Response Every Card Api Cards Get
Response Cards Api Techniques  Technique  Cards Get
Response Offered Api Techniques  Technique  Candidates Get
Response Every Problem Api Problems Get

post.description:
A request the author reads before retiring the problem by hand. No user
retires a problem every user is served.

get.description: Every browser and app signed in as the user, the one asking marked.
The user's whole log, as `climb log export` prints it.

Every live module, at snapshot format 6: `api/snapshot.md`. The
app syncs often and the content moves only at a seed, so an unchanged
snapshot answers 304.

schema.title: Response Board Pick Api Pick Get

post.description:
Stores what the pick predicts as the user takes it, once per pick: a
second take before any outcome returns the first prediction.

One line in the API's log, which the host keeps 14 days:
`api/README.md`.

Arm.title: Arm
Arm.description: Which policy chose the pick, were a comparison to assign one.

Asked.title: Asked
Asked.description:
One attempt the loop still asks about, and the modes its verdict leaves
open. No mode is offered where the record already answers why.

AttemptClaim.title: AttemptClaim
AttemptClaim.description: Which techniques an attempt used, as one writer claimed them.

AttemptVerification.title: AttemptVerification
AttemptVerification.description:
Private to the user, where a solution's run is product data:
`api/attempt-log.md`.

BoardPick.title: BoardPick
BoardPick.description: The pick, named as the board shows it.

CallSite.title: CallSite
CallSite.description:
The calls writing a problem takes. `Bench` names one configuration per
entry, and a test pins the two lists together.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description:
A problem offered for a drill. The statement is left out: the clock
starts when it is served.

Card.title: Card
Card.description:
Teaching content for one technique: forms to reproduce, and a
selector.

CardState.title: CardState
CardState.description:
How far one user's study of one card has gone, derived on every read:
`api/card-states.md`.

CardStatus.title: CardStatus
CardStatus.description:
Where the user stands on a card, as the cards list reads it. Folded on
every read, as the card's own page folds it.

Carry.title: Carry
Carry.description:
What the editor may open on, which `flows/drill-loop.md` gives: the last
attempt's code where it is work in progress, and the bounds the page holds
its own draft to.

Cause.title: Cause
Cause.description: The two-way verdict a diagnosis names: `cli/diagnoser.md`.

ColdFailure.title: ColdFailure
ColdFailure.description: The first case a cold submission failed, by its number alone.

Concept.title: Concept
Concept.description:
A concept as the content browser reads it: `cli/seed.md`. Replaced
whole on each seed, so it carries no retirement.

Diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
Diagnosis.description:
Why an attempt failed, inferred. The machine counterpart of
`SelfLabel`.

ErrorReport.title: ErrorReport
ErrorReport.description:
An error a client met and did not handle. It carries no code the user
typed.

Failure.title: Failure
Failure.description:
The first case a submission failed, shown whole, as `flows/drill-loop.md`
gives.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: One user's feedback on the engine: `api/feedback.md`.

Fill.title: Fill
Fill.description: One user's answer to one key-line item: `api/short-exercises.md`.

FilledItem.title: FilledItem
FilledItem.description: An item as the page shows it: no field says which choice is right.

Focus.title: Focus
Focus.description:
No module clears the focus. A certification is its module, its topic
or none for the whole module, and its level.

Gap.title: Gap
Gap.description:
A core template no solution displays, named as the card names it.

The card claims to teach the form, so the ladder reports the gap rather
than substituting another problem for the rung. The next generation run is
aimed at what this names.

Hint.title: Hint
Hint.description:
What the trainer gives when memory fails, in the order it gives them.
Each answers more of the question than the last.

JudgeExample.title: JudgeExample
JudgeExample.description: One of the template's cases, which states what the code must do.

JudgedItem.title: JudgedItem
JudgedItem.description: An item as the page shows it: no field says whether it is clean.

Judgement.title: Judgement
Judgement.description: One user's answer to one item: `api/short-exercises.md`.

JudgementRates.title: JudgementRates
JudgementRates.description:
Flaws found over the flawed items answered, and clean solutions called
flawed over the clean ones answered. One rate alone hides a user who calls
everything flawed.

Label.title: Label
Label.description: The one mode the solver picked. A skipped label sends no request.

Listed.title: Listed
Listed.description:
One problem on the listing of every served problem. It carries the
problem's techniques, which the page filters by, and no statement.

Me.title: Me
Me.description:
Who the session signs in as. The engine mints the id, and the address is
the provider's, so a user reached by the dev login carries none.

Measure.title: Measure
Measure.description:
The test an answer was given in:
`core-package/knowledge/baseline-tests.md`.

Named.title: Named
Named.description:
One template of the card, as the trainer lists it: what it is called,
whether it is optional, and whether a case can check a reproduction of
it.

Next.title: Next
Next.description:
The spaced check a template waits for, or a graduated card's next due
recall. `owed` is the check's alone.

OpenGrade.title: OpenGrade
OpenGrade.description:
An open question's grade, from the points ticked:
`content-repo/questions.md`.

Pass.title: Pass
Pass.description: The command that clears what waits, as the author runs it.

Picked.title: Picked
Picked.description:
The problem a user picked, before its statement is served. The statement
is left out, as a candidate's is.

Probe.title: Probe
Probe.description:
One problem a run was given, testing whether the form transfers to a
problem it was not studied on. Drawn from outside the ladder.

Probed.title: Probed
Probed.description: One probe the start drew, named as the page shows it.

Prompted.title: Prompted
Prompted.description:
What the trainer shows: the template it asks for, its trigger, the
signature its cases call and the card's templates to switch between. The
form is withheld, and typing it from memory is the recall being
measured.

Provider.title: Provider
Provider.description: Who holds an identity and its login: `api/sign-in.md`.

Rank.title: Rank
Rank.description: The order the pick offers in: `api/pick.md`.

RecallAttempt.title: RecallAttempt
RecallAttempt.description: A form typed into a blank file and run against the template's cases.

Recalled.title: Recalled
Recalled.description:
One template's recall state: the last reproduction of it, and nothing
of the ones before, which stay in the log.

Reproduction.title: Reproduction
Reproduction.description:
What the trainer sends: the form as typed, and the hints taken before
it ran.

Requirement.title: Requirement
Requirement.description:
One edge of the card graph: `content-repo/card-graph.md` gives what it
asserts.

RetirementRequest.title: RetirementRequest
RetirementRequest.description:
One user's request that a problem be retired:
`api/retirement-requests.md`.

Revealed.title: Revealed
Revealed.description: What the page withheld while the sitting ran.

RunFault.title: RunFault
RunFault.description: A user's run the sandbox answered no result for: `api/run-faults.md`.

Rung.title: Rung
Rung.description:
One problem on a ladder, with the templates its canonicals display.

A rung the selector filled covers none. `required` is derived from what the
rung covers rather than stored, and a rung covering the optional template
beside a core one offers that form as the alternative approach.

Seated.title: Seated
Seated.description: A sitting read by its id, with its problem's statement.

Selector.title: Selector
Selector.description:
What a ladder resolves from. Named fields rather than a filter map, so
a new filter is an additive optional field.

SelfLabel.title: SelfLabel
SelfLabel.description: The user's own verdict on why an attempt went the way it did.

SignedInDevice.title: SignedInDevice
SignedInDevice.description:
A live session or app token as its owner sees it. The id is the token's
hash, which signs nothing in.

SolutionRole.title: SolutionRole
SolutionRole.description: Stored rather than inferred: all three pass the same cases.

Stop.title: Stop
Stop.description:
Where the period's writings that did not land stopped: a site's gate, a
gate no site answered for, or the state a held draft waits at.

Studied.title: Studied
Studied.description:
A card as its page reads it. The ladder, the progress and the recall
state are folds, and `content-repo/cards.md` gives why none is stored.

Submitted.title: Submitted
Submitted.description:
The attempt a submission minted, the per-case verdict behind its
`solved`, and the sitting as the submission left it.

Taken.title: Taken
Taken.description: The pick the board showed, which the user took.

TechniqueRow.title: TechniqueRow
TechniqueRow.description: One technique's progress, derived from the log on every read.

Template.title: Template
Template.description: One form reproduced from memory. The unit of recall.

TemplateCase.title: TemplateCase
TemplateCase.description:
One case a reproduced form is checked against. The arguments are
positional, and `solve` is the function they call.

Timed.title: Timed
Timed.description:
A sitting a begin, a start, a pause, a resume or an end moved, with its
elapsed time on the engine's clock.

Unclaimed.title: Unclaimed
Unclaimed.description:
The claim a sitting ends on: the attempts no claim answers yet with the
modes each one's verdict leaves open, and the problem's techniques they are
answered over.

UserLog.title: UserLog
UserLog.description:
Every record of one user's log, and the calls a model made about the
user's code or for the user's request.

Waiting.title: Waiting
Waiting.description: A required card a locked card waits on, named as its page names it.

WritingState.title: WritingState
WritingState.description:
How far a problem has been written. One state per step that can fail,
in the order `cli/generation/states.md` gives; `landed` is where
`ProblemStatus` starts.
